verdicts.reason: A has a garbled collision block left of centre (overlapping text and image fragments that can't be read), pills scattered in three spots (FREE ENTRY/ALL AGES stacked left, TASTINGS floating up top), and the logo is missing, although the headline and the RSVP button on the right read correctly. B has no clear collision, but its hierarchy is inverted: the '6:00 pm until sundown, Harbour Rooftop' location text is bigger than the 'Sunset Sessions' headline, RSVP Free and a same-size FREE ENTRY button compete with each other, and the right side is crammed with micro text and pills that can't be read at this size.
